clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Tirisfal, snapdragons at the Balnir Farmstead may show how far the Scourge's corruption has spread. Anastasia Hartwell sends young Forsaken mages to gather them for study in the Undercity.

Forsaken mages watch the borderlands for signs of magical corruption. Anastasia Hartwell sends novice spellcasters to the Balnir Farmstead in eastern Tirisfal Glades to gather snapdragons from its gardens. The flowers absorb magical energies from the soil and air. By examining them, arcane scholars in the Undercity can judge whether corruption from the Lich King's domain has reached Tirisfal.

The Balnir Farmstead lies near the edge of the glades, close to the blighted wilderness of the Western Plaguelands. The Forsaken know the Lich King's plague rots the land, while Scourge corruption threatens their borders and security. The Forsaken wield dark arts of their own, but Anastasia plans to pass the snapdragons to the apothecaries for study. Mages and alchemists can examine the danger together and help defend Lordaeron's reclaimed heartland.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Plaguelands to the east are an aberration. Devised by the Lich King, they spread their magic into the soil, corrupting and killing all that live. Although there is a certain charm to the destructive forces of the plague, we, the mages of the Forsaken, believe it is unruly and must be curtailed.
But first, we must measure how far it has spread into Tirisfal. Go to the Balnir Farmstead in eastern Tirisfal. In the garden are flowers—snapdragons. Gather these and return.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the snapdragons? That breed of flower is highly receptive to magic energies, and studying the snapdragons so close to the Plaguelands can tell us if the plague has entered Tirisfal Glades.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, a fine specimen this is. I will send it to be studied by our apothecaries to determine the extent of the Plagueland's taint.
Well done, friend. For your services, I present to you this choice: an orb or staff. Whichever you choose, you will find it quite useful.
